mentions.note: centenary-year President; joined February 1936; 3rd AAA 3 miles and 1948 Olympic Games 5000m (London); Surrey 1, 3 and 6 miles champion; GB v U.S.A. and Benelux; Squadron Leader, Pathfinder Group, D.F.C.; Cross Country Secretary 1954-69; President 1963; White City announcer; Vice-President of the A.A.A.

share.d: W.E. (Bill) Lucas in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1986: 1 mention in 1 issue, 1 race result and 1 photograph.
